_sobre: 💡 Nichos de canais de shorts EXPLICATIVOS (em inglês) que dá pra tocar do zero, 1 vídeo por dia, com as imagens geradas no Flow (v84_256). Cada um vira um canal com o perfil 📚 Explicativo + o tema dele.

nichos.nicho: Por que as coisas têm essa forma — o design escondido de objetos do dia a dia e de obras de engenharia
nichos.publico: curiosos de design, engenharia e 'como funciona'
nichos.tom: fascinated, clear, 'once you see it you can't unsee it'
temas: Why tetrapods have four arms
Why manhole covers are round
Why airplane windows are rounded
Why pencils are hexagonal
Why traffic cones are orange and tapered
nichos.visual: close-ups of the object, the object in use, the problem it solves (waves, crowds, wind), slow reveals

nichos.nicho: Truques de sobrevivência dos animais — como cada bicho engana, foge, caça ou sobrevive
temas: How the roadrunner outsmarts the coyote
Why the mantis shrimp punch boils water
How the archerfish shoots its prey
Why flamingos stand on one leg
How the octopus disappears in plain sight
nichos.visual: the animal in its habitat, slow motion action, macro details, the predator and the prey

nichos.nicho: Engenharia que salva vidas — invenções e sistemas de segurança que a gente nem percebe
nichos.tom: suspense, then relief — 'this tiny detail is why you are alive'
temas: The saw that stops when it touches your finger
Why highway barriers are shaped like that
How elevator brakes stop a free fall
Why escape-ramp gravel saves trucks
How a fuse dies so your house doesn't burn
nichos.visual: the danger moment, the mechanism in macro, the test, the saved hand/car/person

nichos.nicho: A origem escondida de símbolos, costumes e expressões — a história por trás do que todo mundo usa
nichos.publico: fãs de história e curiosidades culturais
temas: Why the Grim Reaper carries a scythe
Why we clink glasses
Why brides wear white
Why pirates wore eyepatches
Why we say 'bless you' after a sneeze
nichos.visual: historical reenactment-style scenes, old objects, the modern habit, epic atmospheric shots

nichos.nicho: Como as coisas são feitas — fábricas, máquinas e processos hipnotizantes
temas: How 10,000 pencils are made every hour
How glass bottles are born
How chewing gum is made
How crayons get their color
How a single LEGO brick is molded
nichos.visual: factory lines, machines in motion, raw material to final product, macro of the process

nichos.nicho: O segredo por trás do prato — técnica, ciência e tradição da comida
nichos.tom: warm, appetizing, the 'aha' of the technique
temas: Why ramen chefs throw the noodles in the air
Why bread has holes
Why sushi rice is cooled with a fan
Why pizza ovens are domed
Why caramel turns brown
nichos.visual: close-ups of food, hands working the technique, steam and texture, the finished dish
